brief: @buildthis.bisks.net a website that renders a selected bisk to a grid and then lets you run cellular automata on it - life and Langton's ant would be good but any others that seem fun would be good to include
note: built gameofbisk: pick a bisk, it gets rasterized into a 72×44 grid, then run Conway's Life, Langton's Ant, Brian's Brain, or 4 other automata on it and watch it dissolve.
